notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Netcat can interact with FTP manually for situations where standard FTP clients aren't available. Sends raw FTP protocol commands over TCP. Also useful for testing FTP commands that standard clients abstract away.

=== CHAINING ===
nc TARGET 21 → read banner for version → issue USER/PASS → LIST → RETR file → useful for FTP protocol debugging or extremely restricted environments.

=== BANNER INTEL ===
FTP banner often contains software name and version: vsFTPd 3.0.3, ProFTPD, Pure-FTPd. Version fingerprint enables targeted CVE lookup without nmap.
